audits.risk: Attackers on local Wi-Fi or networks could downgrade HTTPS traffic to HTTP and intercept sensitive user data.

audits.name: CSP (Content Security Policy)
audits.description: CSP controls which domains and resources (scripts, images, styles) can be loaded and executed by the browser.
audits.risk: High risk of Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), clickjacking, and data injection attacks.
audits.recommendation: Define a strict Content-Security-Policy restricting object-src, script-src, and default-src.

snippets.apache: Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none';"

audits.name: X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking Protection)
audits.description: X-Frame-Options prevents the website from being embedded inside an <iframe> on external malicious sites.
audits.risk: Vulnerable to Clickjacking attacks where attackers overlay invisible frames to hijack user clicks.
audits.recommendation: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

snippets.apache: Header always set X-Frame-Options "DENY"

audits.name: X-Content-Type-Options (MIME-Sniffing Guard)
audits.description: Prevents browsers from MIME-sniffing a response away from the declared content-type.
audits.risk: Attackers can upload malicious script files masquerading as images/text and execute them on the client.

audits.name: Referrer-Policy (Privacy & Information Leakage)
